title: 2003 AMC 10B Problem 10
statement: Nebraska, the home of the AMC, changed its license plate scheme. Each old license plate consisted of a letter followed by four digits. Each new license plate consists of three letters followed by three digits. By how many times is the number of possible license plates increased?

solutions.text:
The old scheme allows \(26 \cdot 10^4\) plates and the new scheme allows \(26^3 \cdot 10^3\) plates. The increase factor is \[\dfrac{26^3 \cdot 10^3}{26 \cdot 10^4}=\dfrac{26^2}{10}.\]

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Count the plates in each scheme using the multiplication principle
Divide the new count \(26^3 \cdot 10^3\) by the old count \(26 \cdot 10^4\)
